obligations.requirement: Representative complete-cohort cost per accepted task, acceptance protocol and quadrant spend share
Authenticate principal, ownership, purpose, origin and bounded migration mode
obligations.evidence_required: Negative admission and origin tests; attribution coverage

obligations.requirement: Monotonic source labels and combined restrictions on every block and derived call
obligations.evidence_required: Label corpus and raw negative tests

obligations.requirement: Deterministic rules classifier with owner, corpus and error bars
Capability compatibility and explicit unsupported rejection
Fixed requested approved destination, no substitution, version-controlled approval file
Canonical-work and candidate binding, signed plan and post-callback FDC
obligations.evidence_required: Receiver negative proof on each enabled path

obligations.requirement: Durable intent before transmission; WAL fallback fails closed
Per-attempt raw/normalized usage, unknown status and semantics versions
Per-principal spend limits and alerts without hard concurrent ceiling
Allowlisted redacted telemetry and retention at each persistence boundary
Pinned/hash-verified builds, egress, secrets, SBOM, advisories, soak and rollback
Built-in routing disabled; hooks, retries, license and passthrough attribution verified
Basic 1a reconciliation and full 1b fault reconciliation
Atomic maximum exposure, owner-transfer hold and recovered-state safety
Generation deduplication and single-winner acceptance
Unknown outcome, cancellation, partial output and semantic recovery
Response cache after admission, security-domain isolation and accounting
Versioned registry, split evidence and internal five-way predictor comparison
Presence, capacity, drain, leases and lab production admission
Gated learned routing, rollback and task-level value after overhead
Controlled exploration, propensities, delayed outcome and drift gates
Scheduled exercise of each fallback path with admission and FDC intact

mapping_notes: Phase 1a numbered tests are 1-9 and 37-41; obligations include controls beyond the numbered suite.
First-relying-phase rule applies to enabled capabilities. Unsupported-capability rejection is separate from enabled-path proof.
Phase 0 representative cohorts and Phase 1a operational acceptance cannot be inferred from standalone synthetic results.
